title: Bo-Katan Kryze
description: Bo-Katan Kryze was a gifted warrior from a legendary Mandalorian family and a legend in her own right. As the last of her line, she led Mandalore, wielding the Darksaber, and resisted the Empire —and later its remnants— as they sought to subjugate Mandalore for their own purposes. After the fall of the Empire, Kryze stuggled to unite her without the symbol of the throne. Upon meeting the Mandalorian and Grogu, she found purpose in working together to combat Moff Gideon and his forces.
